name: host file tools
claim: A session whose shell runs on a host, given exact file read, edit and write tools there, changes files without patch scripts and reads regions without head-and-tail views or output_read calls.

models.result: 2026-11-20, real bridge on Windows, WSL user (wsl:) and container (wsl-podman:), scratch folders under /tmp removed after: LF, CRLF, BOM plus non-ASCII with mixed endings, and a 338,781-byte file round-trip byte for byte through write and edit (sha256 on the target); per call median read 0.36 s / 2.1 s, edit 0.66 s / 4.3 s (a read and a write), 300 KB edit 1.3 s / 4.7 s, against 0.34 s / 2.1 s for a bare shell call; a 60-line range of the 300 KB file came back whole (3,417 chars), a whole read is cut at 40,000 chars at a line end and names the lines left; absent and repeated find are classed find-absent and find-ambiguous; .., absolute paths elsewhere and a link leaving the folder are refused. Not measured: a real model.
models.evidence: scripts/test-localbridge.mjs (host files); docs/concepts/HYPOTHESES.md (Host files, tool rounds and run code)

models.result: breach of the rigid order, recorded after the release judge found it (2026-11-20): the names (nomenclature uxdowt, txnskq) and this concept were first written in f71d94c, after the spec 8d94b5a and the implementation b89a7f1, and the concept starts at implemented with no hypothesis line. The red state of suite main was not seen before the implementation; run afterwards at 8d94b5a in the installed Chrome: 245 checks pass and 5 fail (the new host files, round limit and settings-row checks), then the run stops on an exception. History is left as it is.
models.evidence: git log 8d94b5a b89a7f1 f71d94c; CLAUDE.md (rigid order)

models.result: one live session, 2026-11-20, one small task (2 files, +16 -4): 11 file_read and 9 file_edit calls, all accepted, no patch script and no sed; 3 output_read calls (after suite runs); completed in 1 turn, 27 requests, $0.00264, no operator message after the first. Session 1 on a larger task without the tools: 125 requests, 10 python3 and 7 node -e command lines, 44 sed -n. Not a controlled pair: task and four options differ.

H12 canary pair, 2026-11-20, one task, same first message, hostFiles off then on: requests 18 and 18, tool calls 18 and 19, all results ok, cost $0.00147 and $0.00172, prompt tokens 250k and 314k, file writes by script 4 and 0. Fewer requests is not shown; no scripted writes is. Verdict retest.
